description: This file defines the singleton object NotesAppTheme which manages theme preferences such as dark mode for the Android app. It provides methods to get and set the theme preference, persisting the setting using SharedPreferences and applying the theme via AppCompatDelegate.

classes.name: NotesAppTheme
classes.description: A singleton object that manages the application's theme preferences, specifically toggling dark mode, and persists this preference using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: isDarkMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme preference for dark mode from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: setDarkMode
methods.description: Sets the theme preference for dark mode in SharedPreferences and updates the app's theme accordingly.
